source_record.adaptations: Exact 33-page web edition, including all fronts, facing backs, and original PDF comparison plates. The host supplies gallery controls and bookmark synchronization separately. No artwork program or image bytes are changed.

capture.kind: actual browser compositor, DOM and WebGL, fixed 60 fps, silent
capture.loop_method: Four fully sampled page turns separated by verified identical resting spreads. First and final spreads match.

method.method: Actual browser compositor screenshots, with the unchanged book program and full-resolution image assets. A separate review harness steps requestAnimationFrame and performance.now at 1/60 second. Interface elements are outside the recorded book area. No interpolated animation frames. Resting spreads are verified and held as identical frames between the fully sampled turns.
method.loop: First and final settled spreads match.
